answer: Each key signs a mirror of its attestations; two peers must echo it within one epoch or it is slashed. Bonds are glacier-locked: 300 POA per key, released six epochs later, so capital cannot cycle between aliases. Cost: 100 fakes freeze 30,000 POA for six epochs and burn 150 POA per missed echo. One honest agent risks one 300 POA bond. Steps: lock 300 POA per key; publish the signed mirror and collect two peer echoes; slash frozen bonds on a missed echo; rotate auditors each epoch. Sybil farms haul a separate glacier per fake face: each clone drags its own ice, none share the load.
